MALLET WITH FLUTED HANDLE FOR ENT SURGERY 


1. Scope — Dimensional and other requirements for mallet used in ENT surgery.

3. Material — Stainless steel. Designation 22Crl3, or 30013. of Schedule V of IS : 1570-1961

4.1 All

4.3 The mallet shall be passivated and finished dull. 

5. Heat Treatment — The mallet shall be hardened and tempered to 450 to 550 HV. 

6. Tests 

6.1 Performance Test — Drive a 25 mm long flat-head wire nail into a piece of hard wood about 25 mm 
thick. The mallet head shall not become loose and the mallet shall not show any sign of damage. 

6.2 Corrosion Resistance Test — Scrub the sample with soap and warm water, rinse in hot water and 
then dip in 95 percent ethyl alcohol. Diy the sample. Immerse in copper sulphate solution at room 
temperature for 6 minutes and wash off with fresh water or wet cotton wool. 

The copper sulphate solution shall be made up as follows: 

Copper sulphate ( CuS0 4 .5H 2 0 ) 4.0 g 

Sulphuric acid ( H 2 S0 4 ) ( sp gr 1.84 ) 10.0 g 

Water ( H 2 0 ) 90.0 ml

No red stains or spots on the sample shall be allowed but dulling of the polished surface may be 
permitted. 

7. Marking — Each mallet shall be marked with the following: 

a) Manufacturer’s name, initials or recognized trade-mark; 

b) The weight of the mallet; and 

c) The words’ stainless steel'. 

7.1 ISI Certification Marking—Details available from the Indian Standards Institution, New Delhi 1. 

8. Packing — As agreed to between the purchaser and the supplier.
